info.description: OAuth authorization server, dashboard, mobile and public transit API for gezcez. Every response except /v1/oauth/token, /v1/oauth/revoke, /.well-known/*, /health and /ready is wrapped in `{ ok, data }` or `{ ok: false, error }`.
